text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun is exhausted, so I decide to bring her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Thanks so much for worrying about me! I can really tell that you care! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna get some proper rest! Maybe you'll even show up in my dreams. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where am I? And why is there an airplane here?

text_block_list.name: Flight Instructor
text_block_list.text: Your mission, Airman Mayano, is to land on the beach in formation with your trainer, and ring that bell!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I get to fly with Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa! ☆ A couple's flight with Trainer… There's no way I'm gonna mess this up!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Woo! ☆ Great flying, Trainer! But I'm not gonna just sit here and let you outdo me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Touchdown! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay! On the count of three! ♪ One, two… three!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ring, ding, dong!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm still in the infirmary. I must've been dreaming…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That bell sounded kinda like…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I bet that dream was a good omen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her mood improved by her dream, Mayano Top Gun leaves the infirmary with a skip in her step.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: …Huh? I'm losing altitude! Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: The engines! Mayday!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Wait, I was just dreaming?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, c'mon! Even my dreams are frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to shake off her dream, Mayano Top Gun is unable to get proper rest…
